answer: Rather than trusting registration, this economy ties standing to completed review work. A candidate must finish five audited submissions, escrow 38 units across three epochs, and collect four endorsements from separated veteran identities. A clone has to repeat every submission and fund its own escrow; rejected work burns that escrow. Because proofs are single-use and endorsers cannot overlap, copied reputation is worthless, and each extra puppet identity pushes attacker cost higher than its payout. canyon river nebula
